Th e quick pitter-patter of taloned feet speed over dry plains as the axilot rushes past circling scavengers. A dozen of their kind following 
suit, all directed at the large freshly slain carcass being torn apart by a famished predator under the arid day sun. With the sound of a 
sharp crack, it plunges into the fallen beast, its axe-like beak cracking through the ribcage and exposing the nutrient-rich organs for 
a fast snatch and hasty retreat. Its kin plunging in quick succession while the frustrated predator lashes out at the pestering flightless 
birds. With their precious prize held fi rmly in razored beaks, bright scarlet drops trail behind them as they escape the hunting ground. 
Wolfi ng down the meat while on the run, they take no rest as the flock continues their search to steal another meal. 
Class - Aves • Genus Derived Evolution - Geococcyx • Niche - Specialist Scavenger Omnivore
Preyed upon by - Argustaur, Draffer, Grahknash, Khanith, Maedrynn • Preys on - Bloomux, Lhoupin, Tartakka

Encountering Finding an axilot is a much easier task than 
catching one, as the fleet-footed birds are quick to react to 
predators and unknown creatures, rushing off far from their 
reach. Although their striking method is devastating for their 
size, it can also be their downfall if an axilot charges and 
becomes stuck in the carcass, making itself easy prey to be 
caught. 
Unlike most birds, the axilot does not nurture their young, and 
instead leaves a large burrow of them under the soil. With a 
longer incubation than most avians, the fledglings are born with 
ability to immediately leave their nest and safely hide
As its defining trait, the sharp wedge- 
shaped beak is both light and durable.
